summary: Knife River Corp filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its credit agreement, increasing term B loans by $400 million to a total of $895 million and reducing the interest rate margin by 0.25%. The proceeds will refinance existing term loans, repay revolving borrowings, and fund general corporate purposes. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event is disclosed. The filing involves a routine debt refinancing, not a corporate transaction triggering special-situations classification.
